nodes.name: SimpleGridCell.tsx
nodes.summary: Memoized grid-cell component that renders a single subagent's simulator content pane without independent replay controls, using custom equality checks on event signatures to avoid unnecessary re-renders.

nodes.name: SubagentChatPane.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders a scrollable, time-windowed chat transcript for a subagent session up to the current replay cursor, with collapse/expand-all controls and an embedded prompt toggle for the originating task.

nodes.name: SubagentEventPane.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the live/replay activity pane for a subagent session by resolving the current non-empty event, determining its app type, and delegating to CompactEventView for IDE-style event rendering.

nodes.name: SubagentPinnedPreviewPopover.tsx
nodes.summary: Popover component showing a pinned preview of a subagent's TODO list with per-item status icons and blocking-relationship indicators.

nodes.name: SubagentPromptToggle.tsx
nodes.summary: Collapsible toggle button/panel that reveals the raw or parsed task prompt that originated a subagent session, rendered via a portal-positioned dropdown.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file re-exporting the IndependentGridCell and SimpleGridCell grid-cell component variants for consumption elsewhere in the Simulator grid.

nodes.name: subagentCellHeaderIconKind.ts
nodes.summary: Utility that derives which header icon a subagent grid cell should display based on its recent events and whether the session type/status is terminal.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Panel and accompanying hook that requests and caches natural-language explanations of the current simulator step from a local MiniCPM model via the housekeeper account, with debouncing, request-sequencing, and an LRU-style cache.

nodes.name: MultiTaskHeader.tsx
nodes.summary: Header bar shown when multiple background tasks are active in the simulator, displaying the active task count and providing close/minimize controls.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Memoized replay control bar styled like a music player, used for scrubbing and controlling simulator session playback.

nodes.name: SimulatorSingleView.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the single-session view of the simulator content area, showing the active app's content along with an optional floating replay container overlay.

nodes.name: StateDisplays.tsx
nodes.summary: Provides idle and booting placeholder state displays shown in the simulator content area before or during session initialization, with animated transitions.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions for the props consumed by the SimulatorContentArea component family.

nodes.name: useSimulatorContent.tsx
nodes.summary: Hook that resolves which app(s) to render for the current simulator event, tracking retained app types across a session and delegating rendering to the simulator app renderer.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Small floating input component overlay for the simulator, used for live interaction with an active session.

nodes.name: EventFilterDropdown.tsx
nodes.summary: Dropdown control letting users filter which simulator event types are shown, backed by a shared filter atom and a reusable dropdown-positioning engine.

nodes.name: FollowModeDropdown.tsx
nodes.summary: Dropdown control for choosing which app the simulator's camera should follow (auto or locked to a specific app), rendering an icon for the currently followed app.

nodes.name: PlaybackSpeedInline.tsx
nodes.summary: Inline dropdown control for selecting simulator replay playback speed from a fixed set of speed options.

nodes.name: ReplayTimestampSegment.tsx
nodes.summary: Small status-bar segment displaying the current wall-clock timestamp of the active replay position, hidden outside replay mode.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Composite status bar for the simulator, assembling the event filter, follow-mode, playback-speed, and timestamp controls into the simulator's bottom control strip.

nodes.name: tokens.ts
nodes.summary: Shared Tailwind class-name token constants for consistent text and icon-button sizing/styling across the simulator status bar controls.

nodes.name: SubagentPipCard.tsx
nodes.summary: Large picture-in-picture card component that displays a grid of active subagent sessions alongside the main simulator content, supporting resize dragging, banner collapse, session expansion, and pagination across many subagents.

nodes.name: config.ts
nodes.summary: Central configuration module for the Simulator engine defining icon sets, grid layout options, auto-layout calculation, style tokens, and per-event-type icon mappings.

nodes.name: cellReplayTypes.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions for per-cell independent replay state, controls, and the useCellReplayState hook's options/return shape.

nodes.name: getEventRenderSignature
nodes.summary: Builds a stable string signature from a session event's key fields (id, status, text, args, result, etc.) used to detect meaningful re-render changes.

nodes.name: SimpleGridCell
nodes.summary: Memoized grid-cell component wrapping the simulator content area with a custom comparator based on event render signatures to skip unnecessary re-renders.

nodes.name: SubagentChatPaneComponent
nodes.summary: Renders the chat transcript for a subagent session up to the current replay cursor, with collapse/expand-all controls and an embedded prompt toggle.

nodes.name: SubagentEventPaneComponent
nodes.summary: Resolves the current non-empty event for a subagent session and renders it through CompactEventView, computing app type and IDE-specific state along the way.

nodes.name: TodoStatusIcon
nodes.summary: Renders a status icon (done, blocked, in-progress, pending) for a single TODO item based on its status and blocked flag.

nodes.name: SubagentPinnedPreviewPopoverComponent
nodes.summary: Popover listing a subagent session's TODO items with status icons, batch title, and blocked-by indicators.

nodes.name: resolvePromptFromSession
nodes.summary: Scans a session's chat events for the first task-assignment prompt and parses it into a structured prompt object.

nodes.name: SubagentPromptToggleComponent
nodes.summary: Toggle button that opens a portal-positioned dropdown panel showing the parsed or raw task prompt that spawned the current subagent session.

nodes.name: ParsedPromptPanel
nodes.summary: Renders a structured, human-readable view of a parsed task-assignment prompt.

nodes.name: RawPromptPanel
nodes.summary: Renders the raw, unparsed prompt text as a fallback display panel.

nodes.name: resolveSubagentHeaderIconKind
nodes.summary: Determines which header icon variant a subagent grid cell should show based on whether the session type/status is terminal and the color of its most recent event type.

nodes.name: rememberExplanation
nodes.summary: Stores a step explanation in the module-level LRU-style cache, evicting the oldest entry once the cache limit is exceeded.

nodes.name: buildErrorText
nodes.summary: Normalizes an error thrown by the step-explanation request into a truncated, user-presentable error message.

nodes.name: toStepExplainRequest
nodes.summary: Converts a simulator session event into the request payload shape expected by the sessionStepExplain API call.

nodes.name: useMiniCPMStepExplanation
nodes.summary: Hook that tracks the current simulator step, requests a MiniCPM-generated explanation for it (with caching, debouncing, and race-condition guarding via a request sequence ref), and exposes loading/ready/fallback status.

nodes.name: MiniCPMStepExplanationPanel
nodes.summary: Default-exported panel component that displays the current MiniCPM step explanation with a status icon, label, and close button.

nodes.name: MultiTaskHeader
nodes.summary: Header component shown when multiple background tasks are running, displaying the active task count with minimize and close actions.

nodes.name: MusicPlayerReplayBar
nodes.summary: Default-exported, memoized replay control bar with music-player-style transport controls for simulator session playback.

nodes.name: SimulatorSingleView
nodes.summary: Renders the single-session simulator view, showing the active app's content and an optional floating replay overlay when applicable.

nodes.name: IdleState
nodes.summary: Placeholder display shown when the simulator has no active session, before any content has started streaming.

nodes.name: BootingState
nodes.summary: Animated placeholder display shown while the simulator session is booting, with staged fade-in animations and a progress bar.

nodes.name: useSimulatorContent
nodes.summary: Hook that determines the current and retained app types for a simulator event stream and renders the corresponding app content components via the simulator app renderer.

nodes.name: SimulatorFloatingInput
nodes.summary: Small floating input overlay component for the simulator, default-exported for use in the main simulator view.

nodes.name: EventFilterDropdown
nodes.summary: Dropdown that lets users toggle which simulator event types are visible, driven by a shared filter atom and a reusable dropdown-positioning hook, with select-all/clear-all shortcuts.

nodes.name: FollowModeDropdown
nodes.summary: Dropdown for locking the simulator's camera focus to auto or a specific app, rendering the currently followed app's icon and label.

nodes.name: PlaybackSpeedInline
nodes.summary: Inline dropdown for selecting the simulator replay playback speed from a predefined set of options, closing the dropdown on selection.

nodes.name: ReplayTimestampSegment
nodes.summary: Displays the current wall-clock timestamp of the replay position in a fixed-width pill, rendering nothing outside replay mode.

nodes.name: SimulatorStatusBar
nodes.summary: Composite status bar assembling the replay timestamp, event filter, playback speed, and follow-mode controls for the simulator's bottom control strip.

nodes.name: SubagentPipCard
nodes.summary: Picture-in-picture card rendering a resizable grid of active subagent sessions alongside the main simulator content, handling drag-to-resize, banner auto-collapse, session expansion/pagination, and per-session grid-cell rendering via IndependentGridCell.

nodes.name: calculateAutoLayout
nodes.summary: Computes the automatic grid layout key (rows x columns) to use for the simulator grid based on the number of active tasks.

nodes.name: getLayoutCells
nodes.summary: Looks up the number of grid cells for a given layout option, defaulting to 1 if not found.

nodes.name: getLayoutIcon
nodes.summary: Returns the Lucide icon component corresponding to a given grid layout option.

nodes.name: getEventTypeIcon
nodes.summary: Looks up the icon component configured for a given simulator event type.
